sources.access_detail: HF gated:auto. UNBLOCKED 2026-08-11: founder account accepted the terms; read token present on this machine (never committed). Ingest via the `ingest-hf` preset with the token discovered from the environment/HF token file.
sources.notes: APPROVED PRIMARY eval source (+ future train backbone); spontaneous-heavy. Schema verified 2026-08-11: speaker_id, verbatim/normalized transcripts, scenario/gender/age/district. hindi/valid = 5,530 rows (~518 MB); hindi/train = 445,160 rows (~49 GB, NOT ingested — 15D concern).

sources.access_detail: HF gated:auto. UNBLOCKED 2026-08-11 (terms accepted, token present). Ingestion deferred: audio ships as M4A (fname '…-f.m4a'), outside the WAV-only probe — a recorded adapter gap for 15D, not a partial ingest.
sources.notes: APPROVED train source (clean read speech; speaker_id int64, schema verified 2026-08-11). Role: training (15D).

sources.name: negatives-indicvoices-derived
sources.license: CC-BY-4.0 (derivative of IndicVoices audio; attribution carries)
sources.access_detail: derived locally from already-ingested approved clips
sources.notes: Quietest ≥2.5 s windows cut deterministically from approved ingested IndicVoices Hindi clips (parent clip id recorded per candidate); real room tone rather than digital zero, so the no-speech lesson generalizes past exact silence.

sources.name: negatives-synthetic
sources.license: synthetic — generated in-repo, no external rights attach
sources.notes: Deterministic seeded digital silence and low-level noise (M22 Phase 3): teaches `language None<asr_text>` on no-speech input — the exact emission the pinned base model produces and the serving adapter parses to an empty result.

speaker_disjointness: Per-clip speaker ids present for every speech source; the frozen eval's 32-speaker roster is mechanically excluded (speaker_in_eval rejections recorded), and content-hash disjointness is enforced besides. IndicVoices valid-split clips from NON-roster speakers are admitted deliberately (recorded policy: closer to the eval's recording distribution than train-split data, but speaker- and content-disjoint).
curation: deterministic: ascending sha256 order until 30.0h budget met (first crossing clip included); eval disjointness enforced by content hash against stt-hi-public-eval@v1 and by speaker roster (32 speakers)
